NCCL_CH: NCCL channels 8 — lever from tenaiaiai's dsv41-flash-4x-dgx-spark-ja recipe (https://github.com/tenaiaiai/dsv41-flash-4x-dgx-spark-ja)
ROCE: b12x one-shot RoCE all-reduce — Luke Alonso and the b12x contributors (https://github.com/local-inference-lab/b12x), vLLM shim ported from local-inference-lab/vllm
MAX_BATCHED: 16K max batched tokens for prefill — alexellis (glm-5.3-flash-4x-dgx-spark-switchless) and tonyd2wild (GLM-5.3-Flash-4x)
DISABLED_KERNELS: b12x MXFP8 dense GEMM kernel (`B12xMxfp8LinearKernel`, b12x by Luke Alonso and contributors) selected over the CUTLASS path — idea from MiaAI-Lab's DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash-DGX-Sparks write-up (SGLang), re-measured on our stack
WOPROJ: fused MXFP8 inverse-RoPE + WO-A + WO-B output projection — b12x `gemm.wo_projection` (Luke Alonso and contributors); routing idea from MiaAI-Lab's DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash-DGX-Sparks (AGPL, ideas only — no code copied)
KVGROUP: vLLM KV-cache grouping fix (`DSV41_KV_GROUPING=fine`) — our patch, prompted by MiaAI-Lab's KV bytes-per-token accounting and Kai/tonyd2wild's SM12x page-size patch that exposed the padding
NCCL_BUFFSIZE: NCCL pinned connection-buffer knobs (BUFFSIZE / LL128_BUFFSIZE / ^LL128) — MiaAI-Lab's DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash-DGX-Sparks
KV_BYTES: pinned KV cache — our fix for vLLM sizing KV from rank 0 only under the uneven expert split
MEM_MIN_GIB: per-rank memory gate — ours; unconditional load-time flush idea from tonyd2wild
HOT_DIR: resident Engram hot rows — ours (measured regression); 0xSero's Engram-outside-GPU line of thinking
SPEC_K: DSpark draft depth — DeepSeek-AI / vLLM recipes
